goal: Simulate a bounded private-skin implementation packet without changing product source.
success_criteria: The packet selects one writer and one subsystem.
The packet remains within the context and authority budgets.
primary_hypothesis: A single private-skin source concern can be implemented and validated without cross-subsystem context.
discriminating_check: Confirm that all intended paths route to the private-skin subsystem and share one writer.
stop_conditions: The required change crosses a trust boundary.
Another active writer owns an allowed path.
